overview_description.description: Mystic is a provider of infrastructure-as-a-service for data engineers and software developers. It also provides tools and models that enable its customers to deliver robust, dynamic machine learning in an agile manner. Their customers' inquiries are addressed through phone, email, and online applications. Mystic aims to provide data scientists and ML organizations with the engineering tools they need to build end-to-end products faster, with the goal of demystifying how to build scalable ML products.

about_short_description.short_description: Mystic is a provider of infrastructure-as-a-service for data engineers and software developers.

product.name: Mystic Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise platform for deploying and managing machine learning models with scalable performance on GPUs and CPUs across cloud, hybrid, or on-premises environments.

product.name: Mystic Turbo Registry
product.description: A high-performance container registry written in Rust that reduces cold-start times for machine learning models by optimizing container loading and extraction.

product.name: Mystic Serverless API
product.description: A serverless API platform providing access to GPUs and CPUs for running AI models with pay-per-inference pricing, supporting thousands of models with different environments and scaling policies.

product.name: Pipeline AI (Open-source Python Library)
product.description: An open-source Python library and API for packaging, building, and deploying flexible machine learning pipelines across various frameworks and inference engines.
